title: Check text shows the rationale under closed records
lead:
`adj check` text lists closed matches (rejected, withdrawn, superseded) as
`ID  status  title`, with `Superseded by: N` for superseded ones, but not why
the record was closed. The owner decided the text should show the rationale, so
an agent sees why a topic was closed before it considers asking again.
findings_note: Owner decision 2026-10-15 (S10 gate: closed records show only ID, status, title in text)
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** JSON output (it already carries `rationale`); changes to
the match rule, result words or exit codes (C105-C108); showing the rationale
anywhere other than `adj check` text.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decision 2026-10-15 after the S10 gate. The snippet (C130) tells agents to
read a closed record before asking; printing the reason in `check` itself saves
that `adj show` round trip in the common case.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/render/check.go` and `internal/render/check_test.go`.
- `internal/cli/check_test.go` (end-to-end text golden).
- `AGENTS.md` (check entry) and the C110 catalog text.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A rejected match prints an indented `Rationale: <text>` line under its
  `ID  rejected  title` line; same for withdrawn.
- A superseded match prints `Superseded by: N` and its rationale (decide the
  order and record it, C32).
- Multi-line rationale uses the existing indented continuation and trailing
  line-break trimming (C102); an empty rationale prints no line.
- Decided and open output is byte-for-byte unchanged (existing goldens pass
  untouched).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Reuse `writeField` from `render/text.go` with the closed-record indent. The
implementer decides and records (C32) whether to print the full rationale or its
first non-blank line (as `adj context` does, C117), and the label wording.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Run from the repo root after `. scripts/env.sh` (C33):

- `go test ./...` passes, including this slice's new tests.
- `go vet ./...` reports nothing.
- `gofmt -l cmd internal` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. Commit only as the orchestrator
directs; no AI attribution.
